      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Library untuk pengolahan data numerik\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "# Library untuk visualisasi data\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "# Mengambil dataset Breast Cancer dari Scikit-learn\n",
        "from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer\n",
        "\n",
        "# Library untuk membagi dataset dan normalisasi data\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "\n",
        "# Library untuk membangun pipeline dan model klasifikasi\n",
        "from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline\n",
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "\n",
        "# Library untuk evaluasi performa model\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import (\n",
        "    accuracy_score,\n",
        "    precision_score,\n",
        "    recall_score,\n",
        "    f1_score,\n",
        "    confusion_matrix,\n",
        "    classification_report,\n",
        "    roc_auc_score\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Semua library berhasil dimasukkan\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "zPKN_0KoUuIL",

            "Semua library berhasil dimasukkan\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Memuat Breast Cancer Wisconsin Dataset\n",
        "data = load_breast_cancer()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Mengambil fitur dan mengubahnya menjadi DataFrame\n",
        "X = pd.DataFrame(\n",
        "    data.data,\n",
        "    columns=data.feature_names\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Mengambil label atau target kelas\n",
        "y = data.target\n",
        "\n",
        "# Menampilkan dimensi dataset\n",
        "print(\"Dataset Shape:\", X.shape)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Menampilkan lima sampel pertama\n",
        "print(\"\\nFirst 5 Samples:\")\n",
        "print(X.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Menampilkan nama kelas target\n",
        "print(\"\\nTarget Classes:\")\n",
        "print(data.target_names)"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Membagi dataset menjadi 70% training dan 30% testing\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X,\n",
        "    y,\n",
        "    test_size=0.3,\n",
        "    random_state=42,\n",
        "    stratify=y\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Menampilkan jumlah data\n",
        "print(\"Training Samples (70%):\", X_train.shape[0])\n",
        "print(\"Testing Samples (30%):\", X_test.shape[0])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTraining Features:\", X_train.shape)\n",
        "print(\"Testing Features:\", X_test.shape)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "DacxYETUVcZE",
        "outputId": "153fecbd-72e8-4ee3-f6e8-efae4dd45b39"
      },
      "execution_count": 21,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training Samples (70%): 398\n",
            "Testing Samples (30%): 171\n",
            "\n",
            "Training Features: (398, 30)\n",
            "Testing Features: (171, 30)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# 1. Pipeline Logistic Regression (dengan StandardScaler)\n",
        "model_lr = make_pipeline(\n",
        "    StandardScaler(),\n",
        "    LogisticRegression(\n",
        "        max_iter=1000,\n",
        "        random_state=42\n",
        "    )\n",
        ")\n",
        "model_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Model Random Forest Classifier\n",
        "model_rf = RandomForestClassifier(\n",
        "    n_estimators=100,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "model_rf.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training Logistic Regression & Random Forest selesai!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "bG-NPFqNVPc9",
        "outputId": "e12c8368-9302-4a98-f865-1b51803f9cde"
      },
      "execution_count": 22,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training Logistic Regression & Random Forest selesai!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Melakukan prediksi menggunakan data testing untuk kedua model\n",
        "y_pred_lr = model_lr.predict(X_test)\n",
        "y_pred_rf = model_rf.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Prediksi selesai untuk kedua algoritma.\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "Tg3m7LBWcm_S",
        "outputId": "8a30eb46-0e28-4b3c-e556-7f0c809ac184"
      },
      "execution_count": 23,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Prediksi selesai untuk kedua algoritma.\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Menghitung metrik evaluasi untuk kedua model\n",
        "results = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Algoritma\": [\"Logistic Regression\", \"Random Forest\"],\n",
        "    \"Accuracy\": [\n",
        "        accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_lr),\n",
        "        accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_rf)\n",
        "    ],\n",
        "    \"Precision (Macro)\": [\n",
        "        precision_score(y_test, y_pred_lr, average='macro'),\n",
        "        precision_score(y_test, y_pred_rf, average='macro')\n",
        "    ],\n",
        "    \"Recall (Macro)\": [\n",
        "        recall_score(y_test, y_pred_lr, average='macro'),\n",
        "        recall_score(y_test, y_pred_rf, average='macro')\n",
        "    ],\n",
        "    \"F1-Score (Macro)\": [\n",
        "        f1_score(y_test, y_pred_lr, average='macro'),\n",
        "        f1_score(y_test, y_pred_rf, average='macro')\n",
        "    ]\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=== PERBANDINGAN PERFORMA KEDUA ALGORITMA ===\")\n",
        "print(results.to_string(index=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n=== CLASSIFICATION REPORT: LOGISTIC REGRESSION ===\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred_lr, target_names=data.target_names))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=== CLASSIFICATION REPORT: RANDOM FOREST ===\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred_rf, target_names=data.target_names))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Visualisasi dan simpan file evaluation_results.png\n",
        "results_melted = results.melt(id_vars=\"Algoritma\", var_name=\"Metrik\", value_name=\"Skor\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(9, 5))\n",
        "ax = sns.barplot(data=results_melted, x=\"Metrik\", y=\"Skor\", hue=\"Algoritma\", palette=[\"#3498db\", \"#2ecc71\"])\n",
        "plt.title(\"Perbandingan Evaluasi: Logistic Regression vs Random Forest (70:30)\")\n",
        "plt.ylim(0.85, 1.02)\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Nilai Skor\")\n",
        "\n",
        "for container in ax.containers:\n",
        "    ax.bar_label(container, fmt='%.4f', padding=3, fontsize=9)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig(\"evaluation_results.png\", dpi=300)\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "cm_lr = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred_lr)\n",
        "cm_rf = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred_rf)\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot Confusion Matrix Logistic Regression\n",
        "sns.heatmap(\n",
        "    cm_lr, annot=True, fmt=\"d\", cmap=\"Blues\", ax=axes[0],\n",
        "    xticklabels=data.target_names, yticklabels=data.target_names\n",
        ")\n",
        "axes[0].set_title(\"Confusion Matrix - Logistic Regression\")\n",
        "axes[0].set_xlabel(\"Predicted Class\")\n",
        "axes[0].set_ylabel(\"Actual Class\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot Confusion Matrix Random Forest\n",
        "sns.heatmap(\n",
        "    cm_rf, annot=True, fmt=\"d\", cmap=\"Greens\", ax=axes[1],\n",
        "    xticklabels=data.target_names, yticklabels=data.target_names\n",
        ")\n",
        "axes[1].set_title(\"Confusion Matrix - Random Forest\")\n",
        "axes[1].set_xlabel(\"Predicted Class\")\n",
        "axes[1].set_ylabel(\"Actual Class\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig(\"confusion_matrix.png\", dpi=300)\n",
        "plt.show()"

        "# **Step 9: Analisis Hasil Eksperimen & Kesimpulan**\n",
        "\n",
        "### 1. Perbandingan Performa Algoritma\n",
        "Berdasarkan hasil pengujian pada pembagian data **70% training (398 sampel)** dan **30% testing (171 sampel)**:\n",
        "- **Logistic Regression** menghasilkan akurasi sebesar **98.83%** (hanya melakukan 2 kesalahan klasifikasi dari 171 data uji: 1 *False Positive* dan 1 *False Negative* pada kelas Malignant).\n",
        "- **Random Forest Classifier** menghasilkan akurasi sebesar **93.57%** (melakukan 11 kesalahan klasifikasi dari 171 data uji).\n",
        "- **Kesimpulan Algoritma Terbaik:** Pada dataset *Breast Cancer Wisconsin* dengan rasio 70:30, **Logistic Regression memberikan hasil klasifikasi yang lebih baik** dibandingkan Random Forest di seluruh metrik evaluasi (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, maupun F1-Score). Hal ini terjadi karena fitur-fitur numerik pada dataset memiliki pemisahan linear yang sangat baik setelah dilakukan standardisasi menggunakan `StandardScaler`.\n",
        "\n",
        "### 2. Mengapa Accuracy Saja Tidak Cukup dalam Klasifikasi Kanker?\n",
        "Dalam konteks medis seperti deteksi kanker payudara, mengandalkan nilai **Accuracy** saja sangat berbahaya karena:\n",
        "1. **Perbedaan Dampak Kesalahan (*Cost of Error*):**\n",
        "   - **False Negative (FN) pada kelas Malignant:** Pasien yang sebenarnya mengidap kanker ganas diprediksi sehat/jinak (*Benign*). Akibatnya, pasien tidak segera mendapatkan penanganan medis sehingga sel kanker dapat menyebar dan mengancam nyawa.\n",
        "   - **False Positive (FP) pada kelas Malignant:** Pasien sehat diprediksi mengidap kanker. Meski menimbulkan kecemasan dan biaya tes lanjutan (biopsi), kesalahan ini tidak langsung mengancam nyawa.\n",
        "2. **Peran Penting Recall dan Precision:**\n",
        "   - **Recall (Sensitivity)** untuk kelas *Malignant* mengukur seberapa banyak kasus kanker ganas yang berhasil terdeteksi oleh model. Dalam skrining kanker, nilai **Recall harus dimaksimalkan** untuk menekan angka *False Negative* serendah mungkin.\n",
        "   - **Precision** memastikan bahwa prediksi positif benar-benar akurat agar tidak terlalu banyak pasien sehat yang mengalami *overdiagnosis*.\n",
        "   - **F1-Score** menyeimbangkan keduanya sehingga memberikan gambaran performa klinis yang jauh lebih reliabel dibandingkan sekadar melihat *Accuracy* keseluruhan."
